summary: The baseline verifier passed with 54 rows, 48 candidate matches, 40 comparator disagreements and six corruption refusals. All 11 byte-changing mutations were rejected, including the correctly mapped case_id=48 control_accept corruption; the unchanged acceptance control was accepted. However, the frozen runner records positive_control.copy_removed=false because it checks that value before exiting the TemporaryDirectory context. The run therefore did not retain a positive cleanup receipt and exited 1. No rerun or post-outcome source/gate change was made.
